[All reconstruction reports](index.md) · [Material and EOS parameters](../material-summaries/mgal2o4_cafe2o4.md) · [EOSMAT record file](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/materials/mgal2o4_cafe2o4.eosmat) · [Audit sidecar](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/audits/mgal2o4_cafe2o4.audit.json)

Each section opens with the record's reproduction headline and any usage
warning ([label definitions](../eos-labels.md)), then the scope and basis of
the stored check. Only recorded content is shown: missing selections, weights,
errors or conventions are unknown, not zero, and are not inferred. Generating
this page fits nothing and changes no classification or source coefficient.
Every record is also listed by identifier in the
[numerical ledger](../primary-eos-refits.md#records), its
[machine-readable form](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/docs/data/primary-eos-refits.json) and the
[source-audit reports](../source-audits.md).

**Curves and residuals** replay the full stored source and reconstructed
coefficients on the same recorded audit inputs. Residual = model − input in
the fitted quantity's native units; for pressure, P(model) − P(input) at each
input volume and temperature (isothermal records use their reference
temperature). RMS is an unweighted descriptive error, not a parameter
uncertainty or the weighted fitting objective. With more than five
temperatures, the minimum, middle and maximum isotherms are drawn; residuals
include every selected row. Error bars appear only where all widths are
recoverable and keep the source meaning, including digitization widths.
No uncertainty band is inferred.

**Coefficient graphs** show stored central values and recorded error widths
in the audit's units; each panel includes zero. They are not observation or
residual plots. Fixed/adopted values are constraints, not recovered values.
Tables round an error to two significant digits when its leading digit is 1
or 2, otherwise one, and the value to the error's decimal place; values
without a positive error show at most six significant digits. Full precision
stays in EOSMAT and the ledger.

## Funamori et al. (1998), CaFe2O4-type MgAl2O4 BM2

**untested** (not refittable) · `mgal2o4_cafe2o4_funamori_1998_bm2_1` · `BM2` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/mgal2o4_cafe2o4.md#record-mgal2o4_cafe2o4_funamori_1998_bm2_1)

**Warning:** Not recommended for quantitative use. A one-point construction from a single compressed volume; later multi-point measurements are preferred for quantitative use.

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** The source construction is not a regression: recovered V0 is held fixed, K0-prime=4 is assumed, and the only compressed observation determines K0 algebraically. The article has no supplement, and the audit found no associated repository series; the complete reported endpoint evidence is bundled, but it leaves zero independent residual degrees of freedom.

- Usage recommendation: not\_recommended\_for\_quantitative\_use

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** mgal2o4\_cafe2o4\_funamori\_1998\_text\_pv
- **Fixed parameters:** V0

## Irifune et al. (2002), CaFe2O4-type MgAl2O4 BM2

**reproduced** · `mgal2o4_cafe2o4_irifune_2002_bm2_2` · `BM2` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/mgal2o4_cafe2o4.md#record-mgal2o4_cafe2o4_irifune_2002_bm2_2)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.

- Three compressed states only; fixed averaged V0 and implicit K0-prime=4. This unweighted pressure diagnostic differs from the stated normalized-volume objective with unspecified weights. The dedicated reproduction also checks that objective; neither supplies source covariance. The refit error is a residual-scaled diagnostic, not a published uncertainty.

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** mgal2o4\_cafe2o4\_irifune\_2002\_text\_pv
- **Observations:** 3
- **Fit kind:** isothermal\_pv
- **Selection:** fit\_included=1
- **Objective:** pressure\_residuals
- **Absolute sigma:** False
- **Free parameters:** K0
- **Fixed parameters:** V0
